_universalRouterSwapSingleFee(address,ui.details: Internal helper called via try/catch so individual fee-tier failures are recoverable.      Tokens must already reside in this contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.seconds_: TWAP window for large strategy swaps; 0 disables TWAP floor (strict quoter only). Max 24h.

swapAssetToNewAsset(address,address,uint.details: Used by strategy when changing assets. Performs two V3 swaps through WETH.

params.amountIn: The amount of oldAsset to swap
params.newAssetAddr: The new asset address to swap to
params.oldAssetAddr: The current asset address to swap from
params.recipient: The address to receive the newAsset (should be strategy address)

swapExactInputFromStrategy(address,addre.details: Useful for so that V3 just calls this with its own balances.

swapExactInputFromStrategyStrictQuote(ad.details: If QuoterV2 reverts, the whole call reverts. When `strategyTwapPeriodSeconds > 0` and      `amountIn >= largeSwapTwapMinAmount`, `amountOutMinimum` is the max of (quoter-based min, TWAP-based min),      each discounted by `strictStrategySlippageBps`. Fee tier: WETH/USDC uses 3000; otherwise `defaultFee`.      TWAP length is `strategyTwapPeriodSeconds` (owner-tunable; default 10 minutes).

swapToWethViaUniversalRouter(address,uin.details: Caller must have approved this router for `amountIn` of `tokenIn` before calling.      Tries V3 fee tiers 0.05 % → 0.3 % → 1 % in order, reverting only if none succeed.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

strategyTwapPeriodSeconds().notice: TWAP window (seconds) for strategy strict swaps when `amountIn >= largeSwapTwapMinAmount`.

strictStrategySlippageBps().notice: Slippage cap (bps) for `swapExactInputFromStrategyStrictQuote` only (quoter + TWAP min-out).

swapExactInputFromStrategy(address,addre.notice: Swap using tokens already held by a strategy/vault.

swapExactInputFromStrategyStrictQuote(ad.notice: Like `swapExactInputFromStrategy` but **never** uses the weak quoter `catch` fallback.

swapToWethViaUniversalRouter(address,uin.notice: Swap any token to WETH via Uniswap UniversalRouter + Permit2.
